query:
UPDATE tenants
            SET name = COALESCE($2, name),
                domain = COALESCE($3, domain),
                description = COALESCE($4, description),
                status = COALESCE($5, status),
                max_users = COALESCE($6, max_users),
                max_storage = COALESCE($7, max_storage),
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = $1
